evals.name: fixed-two-class-comparison
evals.prompt: Use Cosmos Nano for a fixed two-shot comparison: select two different classes via the frozen SigLIP Mining bank and provide one image from each. The query has no label. Mining/Proxy/Benchmark are already frozen. Give the exact application/data-skill routing and a complete policy config; explain the no-VLM control and when Benchmark is allowed. Do not run inference.

evals.name: maxwell-grid-vs-tools
evals.prompt: I want ICL (1 grid: 8 classes x 4 images), following Maxwell, and a separate grid-plus-tools-plus-guidance arm. Explain deterministic selection, source/asset/runtime requirements, tool loop and output cap, what is and is not historically equivalent, and the commands/receipts. Do not claim synthetic tests prove real model capacity and do not run models.

evals.name: preserve-legacy-and-freeze
evals.prompt: Resume an existing frozen original C nearest-one experiment, then plan a separate new different-class reference study. The first dev trial is better on Proxy but an aggregate Benchmark score suggests another policy. Explain the correct action, how you label frozen/fine-tuned versus references, and whether a 32-example grid is 32 model images. Do not edit the frozen run or run models.
